module: Integral AES 256 Bit Crypto SSD Underlying PCB
description: Integral Crypto SSD is the Full Disk Encryption solution for Windows desktops and laptops. Featuring AES 256-bit Hardware Encryption so you can encrypt and protect your sensitive data and get the speed, reliability and power benefits of SSD. It comes in 32 GB, 64 GB, 128 GB, 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB and 2 TB SATA II & III versions. The devices feature an epoxy resin coating around both the circuit components and the printed circuit board (PCB).
